test.title: A gift you gave to someone

document.cue: Describe a gift you gave to someone.

text: I'd like to talk about a photo book I made for my mother's fiftieth birthday last spring.

It was a hardback album of about sixty pages, with photos from her whole life — from black-and-white pictures of her as a little girl in the village to recent ones with her grandchildren. Under each photo I added a short caption, and for some of them I asked relatives to write a few lines about what they remembered.

I chose it because my mum always says she doesn't need anything, and honestly, it's true — she's not interested in expensive things. But she's very sentimental, and I knew that most of our family photos were scattered across old albums, shoeboxes and different people's phones. I thought it would be special to bring them all together in one place.

When she opened it at the birthday dinner, she went quiet for a moment and then started crying — in a good way. She spent the rest of the evening turning the pages and telling stories I'd never heard before, and the whole table ended up listening to her.
She keeps it on the shelf in the living room and shows it to every guest, which I find very sweet. It taught me that the best presents usually cost more time than money.

tips.en: Went quiet … started crying — in a good way shows emotion through actions.
tips.kk: Went quiet … started crying — in a good way: сезім әрекетпен көрсетілген.
tips.ru: Went quiet … started crying — in a good way: эмоция показана действиями.
tips.example: she went quiet for a moment and then started crying

tips.en: Cost more time than money is a short, memorable idea.
tips.kk: Cost more time than money — қысқа, есте қалатын ой.
tips.ru: Cost more time than money — короткая запоминающаяся мысль.
tips.example: the best presents usually cost more time than money

note.en: What and for whom — straight away, with the occasion.
note.kk: Не және кімге — бірден, себебімен бірге.
note.ru: Что и кому — сразу, вместе с поводом.

note.en: The gift is described in detail: size, photos, captions.
note.kk: Сыйлық егжей-тегжейлі сипатталған: көлемі, фотолар, жазулар.
note.ru: Подарок описан подробно: объём, фото, подписи.

note.en: “Why I chose it” is explained through the mother's character.
The reaction is a scene at the table, not just “she liked it”.
note.ru: Реакция — сцена за столом, а не просто «ей понравилось».

note.en: The ending gives a general lesson about gifts.
